name: Quantitative Chemical Analysis
summary: The analytical process, statistics of measurement and classical wet-chemical methods of quantitative analysis.

topics.name: The analytical process: problem definition, sampling and sample preparation
Measurement errors: systematic vs random; accuracy and precision
Statistics for analysts: confidence intervals, t-tests, F-test and outliers
Calibration: linear regression, standard addition and internal standards
Figures of merit: detection limit, sensitivity, selectivity and linear range
Acid-base titrations in depth, including nonaqueous titrations
Activity, ionic strength and systematic treatment of equilibrium
Introduction to spectrophotometry and Beer's law
Quality assurance, method validation and good laboratory practice
Metrology: traceability, uncertainty budgets and reference materials
